m9e_result.population: 3039 adverse checkpoints plus 852 first-turn entries from Tier-B replay
m9e_result.interpretation: Regular/hidden divergence remains worth studying, but pooled ANY-divergence is not discriminative because older causal divergence persists across many timeframe/oscillator/scale contexts.

m9f_research_order: Keep regular and hidden divergence separate; do not collapse them to one universal flag.
Normalize divergence age by its own timeframe and compare <=2, <=3, <=5 and <=10-bar observation windows without promoting a cutoff.
Separate divergence whose two pivots formed after the original signal, second pivot only after signal, and fully pre-signal context.
Compare supportive-only, opposing-only, both and neither signatures separately for XAU/BTC, LONG/SHORT and month.
Retain RCI9/14/18 and MACD line/histogram, timeframe and pivot-scale identities for individual-context analysis.
Use M9F only for hypothesis generation; any promising divergence/state combination requires separate temporal/forward validation.
